claims.statement: For factors g_j=chi_{R_j} f_j with arbitrary reused character sets R_j on one shared physical block and pairwise-disjoint residual Boolean factors f_j, H(product g_j)=sum H(f_j) and I(product g_j)=|triangle_j R_j|+sum I(f_j). Thus any common FEI constant C is preserved exactly.
claims.scope: Arbitrary finite dimension, factor count, overlap count, reuse multiplicity, cancellation pattern and composition depth; shared dependence must be character-only.

claims.statement: The gauge-corrected potential E(a+hb)-E(hb)+E(b) is not monotone under a shared physical restriction. A genuine three-bit Boolean witness has decrement -(5/4-(9/16)log_2(16/9))< -11/16 while the decrements of F,a,b all vanish.
claims.scope: Exact Boolean witness; also refutes repair by any fixed linear combination of the separate raw entropies E(a),E(b).

claims.statement: Character-only overlap is closed exactly. General non-character shared coordinates still require a joint signed four-channel collision potential or credit.
